tagline: A leading U.S. producer of metallurgical coal for the steel industry
hero_kpi_rationale: Essential KPI for a metallurgical coal mining company: reserves determine asset life and future production capacity, critical for assessing the company's long-term viability.

kpis.name: Coal Reserves
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of economically recoverable coal remaining in mines.
kpis.description: Coal reserves are the foundation of the company's value. Substantial reserves ensure sustainable production.
kpis.signal: Reserves stable despite production, with new acquisitions.

kpis.name: Diesel Fuel Purchases
kpis.explanation: Annual volume of diesel purchased for mining operations.
kpis.description: Estimated purchase of 22 million gallons of diesel in 2026 exposes the company to fuel price fluctuations.
kpis.signal: Significant exposure to fuel prices, a major risk to profitability.

kpis.name: Trading Securities
kpis.explanation: Value of short-term security investments held by the company.
kpis.description: The company holds trading securities primarily in U.S. government bonds with maturity under 12 months.
kpis.signal: Cash invested in secure short-term securities.

kpis.name: Credit Facility
kpis.explanation: Maximum amount available under the secured credit line.
kpis.description: $225 million credit facility secured by assets, undrawn as of end 2025.
kpis.signal: Flexible financing capacity without current borrowing.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, value extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Total Revenue of €2.13B in latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total Assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total Assets of €2.28B in latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total Debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total Debt of €0.01B in latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & Equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash & Equivalents of €0.37B in latest year

risks.title: Commodity Price Risk
risks.score_rationale: Price risk is elevated due to coal price fluctuations and production costs. The company is exposed to price risks for supplies such as diesel, steel, and explosives.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to potential interest rate risks due to its variable rate credit facility. However, no borrowing was outstanding as of end 2025, limiting current exposure to zero.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company sells coal internationally in U.S. dollars. Currency fluctuations can reduce competitiveness against competing producers if their currencies declined, impacting margins.

risks.title: Mine Closure and Reclamation Obligation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Major existential risk identified as Critical Audit Matter. Asset retirement obligations estimated at $227 million as of December 31, 2025. Strict environmental regulation and high reclamation costs, based on complex assumptions about discount rates, inflation, and disturbed acreage, could materially impact future operational and financial results.

ai_positioning.summary: AMR has no significant mentions regarding artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts from its 10-K filing.
